title: The moving stairs
goals: Ask the stair whether it is in place.
starting_code:
# Wait for the stair.
# Then cross.
hints: Walk up two times and right one time. This reaches the gap.
Use `while` and `not` with `stair.in_place` to wait for the stair.
Wait under the loop. Move right four times when it stops.
intro: The stairs here swing back and forth. You must wait for them. Let us see if you can cross the gap.
outro: You crossed perfectly. The moving stairs are no trouble for you.
learned: Now you know how to wait for a moving thing with a `while` loop.
